components.note: 15 points each, must attend at least two

grading.scale: Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory: 210 of 275 points required to pass; under 76% of points, or fewer than two Professional Development Seminars, is Unsatisfactory
grading.drop: One missed seminar (0 of 5 points) is dropped from the attendance grade.

materials.item: A professional development book of the student's choice (for the book report)

WASH 3400.attendance: Be on time (within 5 minutes of start) and attend all classes except one, unless absent for illness; active participation expected and device distraction can be marked absent.
WASH 3400.lateWork: Reflection assignments are due Mondays 11:59pm; none accepted after the posted deadline.
other: Generative AI is strictly prohibited on reflections, assessments, and the book report; the portfolio text may not be AI-written (AI allowed only for formatting
Failing to attend two Professional Development Seminars gives Unsatisfactory regardless of points.
Must complete a full-time internship while in the Washington Semester Program to earn credit.
